title: Adhoc crosslink scratchpad - weekend surge & contact ledger
content:
Purpose:
Quick, ad-hoc spreadsheet used during the July weekend surge spike to centralize who-to-loop, lightweight ETA estimates, temporary fallbacks, and one-off fixes. Not canonical; use for immediate routing and handoffs only.

How to use:
- Single-line rows for each item. Keep entries terse.
- If you change owner/status, append a 1-line update in Notes with date initials.
- This is a living scratchpad; copy rows into official trackers later if they become persistent.

Table (ID | Owner | Team | Context | Action | ETA | Est Hours | Priority | Status | Notes)
1 | Luis O. | infra | Dedicated GPU pool flapped in us-west-2 at 03:18 UTC | temp-route traffic to eu-north fallback, remove unhealthy hosts | 2024-07-06 04:30 UTC | 1.0 | P1 | in_progress | Luis: reroute applied 04:05 UTC; monitor for 2h.
2 | Maya C. | product | Unexpected embed-credit billing spike for a small cohort of customers (batch job re-run) | block/limit bulk-embed jobs + notify CS | 2024-07-06 06:00 UTC | 0.5 | P2 | actioned | CS pinged, limiter set to 200 req/min for now (Maya 07/06).
3 | Imani P. | console | Canary rollout caused duplicate metrics for route /v1/chat on metrics pipeline | roll back canary /v1/chat -> stable v1.3 | 2024-07-06 05:00 UTC | 0.5 | P1 | done | Imani rolled back and cleared duplicate alerts 05:22 UTC. Follow-up: small PR to guard metric tag dedup.
4 | Derek H. | serving-runtime | KV cache growth > expected for long prefix sequences from a partner test | apply temporary TTL trim at 3m on session cache | 2024-07-06 06:30 UTC | 1.5 | P1 | in_progress | Derek to validate tail latency post-change.
5 | Oncall | sre | Pager: outage threshold on region eu-west-1 (spike in 5xx) | escalate to infra + platform, open incident bridge | 2024-07-06 03:40 UTC | 2.0 | P0 | incident | Bridge: https://zoom.fake/bridge-999 (added 07/06). Assigned SRE: Priya Singh.
6 | Product PM | product | Customer demo failing: function call timeouts when using long system prompts | short-term: increase per-request timeout to 12s | 2024-07-06 07:00 UTC | 0.25 | P2 | planned | Add note to demo playbook; follow-up tech debt ticket.
7 | Solutions Eng | se | SE pilot hitting quantization fallback, performance regression on MQA model | pin to previous quant profile + notify infra about rollback window | 2024-07-06 08:30 UTC | 0.75 | P2 | planned | SE to coordinate with infra on reserved capacity.
8 | Legal/Compliance | security | Customer requested log snapshot for a data access review (fast lane) | pull redacted logs + secure upload link | 2024-07-06 09:30 UTC | 1.5 | P1 | queued | Need legal approval before upload; ticket LEG-104 in review.
9 | Ops | product-ops | Small partner needs temporary quota increase for weekend traffic | grant 2x quota for 48h with monitoring | 2024-07-06 04:00 UTC | 0.25 | P3 | done | Quota granted until 2024-07-08 04:00 UTC (Maya).
10 | Observability | observability | Spike in embedding latency correlated with new tracer sampling | disable sampling key 'trace-experimental' for 6h | 2024-07-06 05:15 UTC | 0.2 | P2 | done | Reverted sampling; latency back to baseline 05:50 UTC.

Quick metrics and snapshot:
- Current open P0/P1 items: 3 (IDs 1,4,5)
- Estimated total ad-hoc effort if all escalate: ~7.2 engineer-hours (rounded)
- Contacts dialed: SRE oncall (Priya Singh), Infra oncall (Luis Ortega), SE lead (Derek Hsu), PM (Anika Rao)

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Which of these require formal incident writeups vs one-line completion notes? Recommend incident for ID 5, postmortem for ID 1 if root cause not fixed.
- Should embed-credit spike (ID 2) be surfaced as a billing anomaly to Finance? (cc: finance-ops)
- Derek: validate whether TTL trim introduces user-visible regressions (deadline 2024-07-07 EOD).

Short to-do (owner -> action):
- Luis: continue monitoring us-west-2 for 24h; escalate to infra if error-rate >2%
- Maya: create quick billing anomaly note and add CS thread link
- Imani: open small PR to dedupe metrics tags; assign reviewer

Notes to self:
- This doc is ephemeral; copy critical rows to the central incident tracker if any item becomes persistent.
- Keep messages short when copying into Slack; include ID and one-line status update.

Raw links & refs:
- Incident bridge (temp): https://zoom.fake/bridge-999
- Billing quick-view: https://billing.internal/reports/weekly
- Metrics PR placeholder: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics/pull/---

Timestamped updates (last 3):
- 2024-07-06 05:22 UTC - Imani: rollback done for /v1/chat canary.
- 2024-07-06 04:05 UTC - Luis: us-west-2 reroute applied.
- 2024-07-06 05:50 UTC - Observability: sampling revert completed, latency normalized.

End of scratchpad.
